policies.title: Armenian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked schedule requires Armenian visitors to obtain a visa before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Armenian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a mission or consulate before travel.
The active schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if replaced.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Armenian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Armenian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Armenian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Armenian ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Armenia in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Armenian passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Armenian ordinary passports: Türkiye electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's live nationality schedule makes ordinary Armenian passports eligible for an eVisa delivered electronically before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Armenian passport holder travelling for tourism or commerce through the official eVisa route.
Complete the application and payment online, then download the issued eVisa before travel.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Türkiye eVisa application
steps: Start an application using the ordinary Armenian passport details and travel dates.
Enter the required information and pay electronically.
Download the issued eVisa before departure and carry a copy for border presentation.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry schedule and official eVisa service establish electronic issuance before travel for ordinary Armenian passports; they do not describe an arrival-issued route.
